messages:
aria (eng-platform): quick thread — spotted a customer in the EU (ACME-EU) on Private who has control-plane egress blocked. our current smart-routing falls back to hosted-us and fails the request. need a policy/UX decision: prefer region-local model variants, then degrade to reduced features, only attempt cross-region control-plane if tenant consents.

matt (infra): ugh yeah that's a known gap. current routing orders: tier -> lowest-cost -> region-agnostic fallback. we never inserted an 'egress-allowed' predicate.

jules (product): proposed wording for console: "If your network blocks outbound control-plane traffic, enable 'Control plane egress consent' to allow cross-region model fallback. Otherwise requests will use local-only variants or return graceful failures." thoughts? :thinking_face: 

sam (eng-runtime): technically simple: add predicate in router: allowed_by_egress && region_pref then model_variant, else if !allowed_by_egress -> use local_compat_variant OR return 409 with 'egress_restricted' metadata so SDKs can surface. can sketch patch.

aria (eng-platform): SGTM. two follow-ups: 1) telemetry — we need a new metric 'private.tenant.egress_blocked.fallback_attempts' and tag by region + tier, 2) rollout UX — console should show a per-tenant 'egress consent' toggle and highlight how many requests were failing due to restrictions.

matt (infra): for telemetry we should also sample request traces with a small payload (no customer data) — just headers and decision path. sampling key: tenant_id, model, route_decision. add to telemetry-privacy doc.

jules (product): for UX mock: show a yellow pill on the tenant page if >0 failed attempts, with CTA: "Enable cross-region fallback" and a small explainer modal. if they click, record consent and audit log. if they refuse, show "local-only mode" with recommended model variants and a 'degraded capabilities' note.

sam (eng-runtime): code sketch I pasted in the thread:

```yaml
routing_policy:
  - predicate: tenant_allows_controlplane_egress
    order: region_preferred
    action: route_to_best_variant
  - predicate: tenant_blocked_egress
    order: region_only
    action: route_to_local_compat_variant_or_respond_409
  - predicate: default
    action: cross_region_fallback
```

aria (eng-platform): perfect. also need API change note: add new header 'X-Tenant-Egress-Consent: true|false' so SDKs can set it at request time. default = false for private tenants.

jules (product): agree on header. For Console audit UI: show history with timestamp, who toggled consent, and link to the samples.

matt (infra): operational ask: we should add an alert in SRE if region-local variant utilization > 95% while cross-region capacity idle — could indicate silent egress blocks causing load imbalance.

aria (eng-platform): action items: @matt to add predicate + alert, @sam to implement router change + header, @jules to ship console mock + modal copy, I'll add telemetry metric and drafting the API note. target: canary to 10% private tenants next week.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: routing-service v2.18 -> canary (10% traffic) :rocket:

matt (infra): I'll hold the infra PR for the alert until sam's router PR lands so we can test.

sam (eng-runtime): will open PR today with unit tests around blocked-egress decision paths. I'll include example SDK error: 409 {"error":"egress_restricted","retryable":false,"hint":"enable_cross_region_fallback_in_console"}

aria (eng-platform): awesome. let's sync offline if any legal/privacy flags. thanks all :raised_hands:
